purpose: the loader now has a ConvRot INT8 route for CLIP Vision; this records what it does on this pack

implementation.how: load_clipvision_from_sd builds the tower, then every layer the pack declares is swapped for comfy.ops.mixed_precision_ops' own Linear and its {weight, weight_scale, bias, comfy_quant} is loaded into it
implementation.why_needed: comfy.clip_vision builds with comfy.ops.manual_cast, which never calls _load_quantized_module, so a comfy_quant layer keeps its int8 codes in a float Parameter
implementation.scope: CLIP Vision only - no shared module is modified; a file without comfy_quant still goes through comfy.clip_vision.load unchanged

render.route: ipadapter_execute(model, ip-adapter-plus_sd15, clip vision, weight 0.8 linear, V only) then 24 steps dpmpp_2m/karras cfg 7.0 seed 42 at 512x512
render.D_vs_F_read: same scene, same subject, same composition; the per-pixel difference is FP16 rounding through sampling

conclusion: The pack now executes as ConvRot INT8 on this machine: 92 of 92 declared layers armed, 184 INT8 GEMM calls per render, image embed cosine 0.999979585 against the source, and a render that carries the source's scene. Before this route existed the same pack produced an exactly black frame (mean 0.00, std 0.00) because the codes were read as floats.
